english.title: Occupier fail to ensure premises maintained and operated in accordance with conditions / requirements
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of premises approved, authorised, licensed or registered under the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (Wales) Regulations 2018, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that those premises were maintained and operated in accordance with

(A)_[the conditions of the approval, authorisation, licence or registration,]_
(B)_[the requirements of the EU TSE Regulation and the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (Wales) Regulations 2018,]_

in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 8(a) and 20 of the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (Wales) Regulations 2018.
